items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: I know I played it with him.

ctx.x: That's part of the quadrilles. Yeah, the lances and the quadrilles. Varieties?

What is that like, varieties? Have you ever seen them? Yeah. Lenny used to tell me about it. That's how I... I never knew the name of all of them, but I know I played it with him. I played corpule for bankers, for French later society, you know. And they'd stop a while and then the guy would call out something in Creole, a figure like, and then they'd start again. The music would probably call a variety would be different temples. Maybe I'll just say that. Yeah. Well we'll ask my name Senegal sometime, we'll get…
